sources.title: Anoopsingh53/NextBharat-V2-Final · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NextBharat V2 is a fine-tuned version of Llama-3.1-8B, specifically optimized for regional Indian languages and student-centric queries. Developed at NextMatrix Lab, this model aims to bridge the language gap for students in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
